description: Return this server's machine-readable capability handshake: capabilities, numeric limits, retired tool names with their replacements, and traps (ways a result misleads, each with the response field that proves it fired). Call it first from a programmatic client: inputs are strict, so an argument an older build lacks (e.g. `shape`, response_format:'none') is a hard validation error that fails the whole call, and tools/list cannot reveal argument support — gate each new argument on its capability string. Cache by brief_hash and re-fetch only when it changes. Constants only: needs no library access and does not fail. Example: {} or {response_format:'json'}.

response_format.description: Format of the human-readable text: 'markdown' (default) for display; 'json' the same data as one JSON code block; 'none' only a one-line pointer, leaving structuredContent as the whole answer. structuredContent is always returned, so a caller that parses it should pass 'none': the character budget counts both channels, and the unread copy otherwise spends most of it. Requires the 'response_format.none' capability (see shamela_get_brief).

name: shamela_get_brief

brief_hash.description: Digest of every other field; re-fetch only when it changes.

capabilities.description: Arguments and response fields this build supports; gate new arguments on these.

tool_aliases.description: Retired tool names mapped to their replacement and argument changes.

act.description: What to do when it fires.

detect.description: Response field that proves it fired (relaxed_min_match, zero_hit_terms, paging_ceiling, coverage.sample_is_complete, scope_resolution.dropped, madhab_source, probes[].qualifiers, …): check it, not prose.
